_note: Codex process identities. recognizes() classifies one process by its own comm + argv, so a codex process is recognized whether or not it runs under an srt/bwrap sandbox — the wrapper is a separate ancestor process whose own identity does not match, so it belongs in noMatch. Finding the codex process inside a wrapped tree is the process walker's job, not the recognizer's. OMX is its own kind (ADR 0005): its wrapper never matches here, and the walker meets that wrapper before the Codex child it launches, so a Codex process is badged Codex only when no OMX ancestor claimed the pane. Match/no-match cases mirror processes.test.ts.
